nodes.name: pressure-move-scene-affinity
nodes.rationale: When several threat fronts could supply a pressure move, the one sharing the most specific structured reference with the scene wins: a clock the scene names beats a shared danger, which beats a scene id, and so on down to an unmatched fallback.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint where two fronts match at different rungs; swap two adjacent rungs and compare which front supplies the pressure move.

nodes.name: Dying tick uses the hour clock once stabilized, the round clock otherwise
nodes.rationale: When an investigator is dying the Director asks the rescue engine for a dying tick and chooses the clock granularity, rather than requesting a generic CON check that could narrate death without applying it.
nodes.origin: coc_story_director control branch, grounded in the coc7 RuleGraph

nodes.name: A dying investigator hands the scene to the rescue subsystem
nodes.rationale: Dying is the one HP state that overrides scoring entirely, because the death clock and durable dead state belong to the rescue engine and not to a pacing decision.
nodes.origin: coc_story_director control branch, grounded in the coc7 RuleGraph

nodes.name: storylet-selection / conflict-rank-gap
nodes.rationale: A storylet one conflict level away from the target keeps three quarters of its weight and never drops below about a third, so an off-level beat stays reachable when nothing on-level qualifies.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes where only off-level storylets pass the gates; vary the floor and compare whether an off-level beat is picked or none is.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / family-repeat-penalty
nodes.rationale: A storylet whose family has already been used this session keeps under half its weight, so families rotate without a family ever becoming unusable.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint whose ledger already used one family; vary the penalty and compare how often that family returns.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / polarity-match
nodes.rationale: Matching the trigger's polarity outweighs every individual serves bonus, so tone alignment beats mechanical usefulness by one step.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes where a polarity-matched storylet serves nothing and a clue-serving storylet is off-polarity; compare the pick.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / scene-tag-generic-suppression
nodes.rationale: While a scene tag has summoned a beat, generic storylets are suppressed to a hundredth rather than zero, so a generic remains a fallback when no summoned candidate passes the other gates.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes where every summoned candidate is gated out; set the suppression to zero and confirm whether the turn loses its beat entirely.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / scene-tag-summoned-boost
nodes.rationale: A storylet summoned by a scene tag is boosted far above the ordinary range, because the generic ambient pool's aggregate weight grows with its size and a modest boost leaks.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene-tag-summoned turn with a large generic pool; lower the boost and count how often a generic still wins.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / serves-deepen-npc
nodes.rationale: A storylet that can deepen a present NPC ranks below front-ticking.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with an agenda NPC present and a live front; compare the pick.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / serves-reveal-clue
nodes.rationale: A storylet that can carry an available clue is the strongest of the four serves bonuses.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint with an available clue and both clue-serving and front-serving candidates; compare which is picked.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / serves-surface-choice
nodes.rationale: Surfacing a choice is the weakest of the four serves bonuses.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with a choice frame and an available clue; compare the pick.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / serves-tick-front
nodes.rationale: A storylet that can tick a live threat front ranks just below one that can reveal a clue.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with a near-full front and an available clue; compare the pick.

nodes.name: storylet-selection / trope-repeat-penalty
nodes.rationale: A repeated trope is penalised less than a repeated family, so a family rotates faster than the tropes inside it.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with a used trope but unused family; vary the penalty and compare trope repetition across a session.

nodes.name: CHARACTER / agenda-npc-in-scene
nodes.rationale: An NPC with an authored agenda puts CHARACTER in the upper-middle of the range, below investigate REVEAL and above DEEPEN.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint with both an available clue and an agenda NPC; vary this value and compare REVEAL-vs-CHARACTER.

nodes.name: CHOICE / two-undiscovered-clues
nodes.rationale: Under idle, ambiguous or stuck intent with at least two undiscovered clues, CHOICE scores level with CHARACTER.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes from a stuck-intent checkpoint with exactly two undiscovered clues; vary this value and compare against the redirection path.

nodes.name: CUT / exit-condition-met
nodes.rationale: A satisfied scene exit condition under low-agency continue scores CUT level with stalled PRESSURE.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes from a checkpoint whose exit condition is met while a threat clock is near full; compare CUT-vs-PRESSURE.

nodes.name: CUT / explicit-move-intent
nodes.rationale: An explicit move intent with a resolved destination makes CUT the maximum possible base score, so movement wins unless a structure weight below 1.0 pulls it under another action.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a move-intent checkpoint under hub_sandbox (CUT weight 0.7); confirm whether movement still wins after weighting.

nodes.name: CUT / main-line-complete
nodes.rationale: Once every core objective is worked out, a non-final scene generates transition pressure below a met exit condition, so the Keeper can still override by simply moving.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes from a main-line-complete checkpoint in a non-final scene; vary this value and compare whether the Director pushes toward the ending.

nodes.name: CUT / stalled-transition-pressure
nodes.rationale: From two stalled turns, CUT rises as 0.45 + 0.15 x stalled capped at 0.85, so it reaches the stalled-PRESSURE and RECOVER band at three stalled turns rather than immediately.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes replaying a checkpoint at two, three and four stalled turns; compare the turn at which CUT overtakes RECOVER.

nodes.name: DEEPEN / dramatic-question-present
nodes.rationale: DEEPEN only competes mid-range, so it rarely beats REVEAL or PRESSURE and mostly surfaces when both are unavailable.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint with a dramatic question and no available clue; vary the DEEPEN base and compare against the CHOICE no-trigger default.

nodes.name: MONTAGE / montage-intent
nodes.rationale: Explicit montage intent scores just above DEEPEN, so montage is reachable but loses to any triggered REVEAL or PRESSURE.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a montage-intent checkpoint that also has an available clue; compare MONTAGE-vs-REVEAL.

nodes.name: PAYOFF / structured-entity-overlap
nodes.rationale: PAYOFF rises as 0.15 + 0.12 x overlap capped at 0.85, so a single weak entity match stays below every triggered action and only multi-entity overlap competes.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint with one-entity and three-entity temporal overlap; compare when PAYOFF first wins.

nodes.name: PRESSURE / baseline
nodes.rationale: With no stall and no near-full clock, PRESSURE stays in scoring at a low value rather than dropping out, so a high structure weight can still surface it.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a calm checkpoint under the multi_faction weight (PRESSURE 1.2); vary the baseline and compare whether PRESSURE ever wins from calm.

nodes.name: PRESSURE / cautious-posture-adjust
nodes.rationale: A cautious risk posture lowers PRESSURE by one tenth, floored at 0.05, so pressure is tempered but never removed from scoring.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes replaying one checkpoint with cautious and neutral posture; compare selected action at equal base.

nodes.name: PRESSURE / clock-near-full-or-stalled
nodes.rationale: A near-full threat clock or a single stalled turn puts PRESSURE just below the yielded-scene value and above all mid-range actions.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes from a checkpoint with one stalled turn; vary this value and compare selected action.

nodes.name: PRESSURE / pushed-fail-nudge
nodes.rationale: A legal pushed-roll failure nudges PRESSURE once by one tenth, capped at 0.95, realising the rulebook's consequence-follows-a-pushed-failure requirement as a pacing preference rather than a gate.
nodes.origin: Keeper Rulebook 40th Anniversary p.83-85, cited in coc_story_director._base_score

nodes.name: PRESSURE / reckless-posture-adjust
nodes.rationale: A reckless risk posture raises PRESSURE by one tenth, capped at 0.95, so posture can flip a tie but cannot by itself promote the baseline above a mid-range action.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes replaying one checkpoint with reckless and neutral rich-intent posture; compare selected action at equal base.

nodes.name: PRESSURE / yielded-scene
nodes.rationale: After the player has yielded the scene twice with pressure available, PRESSURE outscores REVEAL's social value and every mid-range action.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes from a checkpoint with two recorded low-agency continues; vary this value and compare whether the Director escalates or keeps revealing.

nodes.name: RECOVER / stalled-turns
nodes.rationale: From two stalled turns RECOVER scores level with yielded-scene PRESSURE, and RECOVER's second place in the tiebreak order decides between them.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes from a two-stall checkpoint with pressure available; confirm the tiebreak resolves to RECOVER and compare play quality.

nodes.name: REVEAL / investigate-intent
nodes.rationale: With an available un-revealed clue and investigate intent, REVEAL enters scoring near the top of the range, so it wins unless a structure weight or a Layer-3 override displaces it.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Two production lanes on one settled investigation checkpoint, REVEAL base varied against the committed value; compare selected action and whether the turn still delivers the clue.

nodes.name: REVEAL / social-intent
nodes.rationale: Under social intent REVEAL scores below its investigate value, so a scene with an agenda NPC can reach CHARACTER instead.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Two lanes on a social checkpoint with an agenda NPC present; vary the social REVEAL base and compare REVEAL-vs-CHARACTER selection.

nodes.name: SUBSYSTEM / combat-flee-cast-intent
nodes.rationale: Combat, flight or spellcasting intent scores level with investigate REVEAL, and SUBSYSTEM's first place in the tiebreak order resolves that tie in its favour.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint with both combat intent and an available clue; confirm the tiebreak resolves to SUBSYSTEM.

nodes.name: choice-undiscovered-clue-count
nodes.rationale: CHOICE requires at least two undiscovered clues so that offering a choice is meaningful.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with one and two undiscovered clues under stuck intent; compare CHOICE availability.

nodes.name: clue-policy-lead-count
nodes.rationale: A clue policy offers at most two leads, so the Keeper is pointed rather than handed the whole route ledger.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene with five available clues; vary the lead count and compare whether the Keeper's reveal stays focused.

nodes.name: clue-route-default-priority
nodes.rationale: A clue without an authored route priority is treated as exactly mid-priority, so unauthored clues neither lead nor trail authored ones.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene mixing authored and unauthored route priorities; compare route ordering.

nodes.name: compression-max-beats-ceiling
nodes.rationale: An authored max_beats above eight is clamped down, bounding how long a scene may idle.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with an authored max_beats of sixteen; confirm the clamp and compare pacing.

nodes.name: compression-max-beats-default
nodes.rationale: A scene without an authored compression budget compresses low-agency play into at most four beats.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a low-agency stretch with the default and a doubled cap; compare beats spent before the Director forces progress.

nodes.name: compression-max-beats-floor
nodes.rationale: An authored max_beats below two is clamped up, so no scene can compress to a single beat.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with an authored max_beats of one; confirm the clamp and compare pacing.

nodes.name: compression-max-minutes-ceiling
nodes.rationale: An authored max_minutes above thirty is clamped down, bounding time skipped inside one scene.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with an authored max_minutes of ninety; confirm the clamp.

nodes.name: compression-max-minutes-default
nodes.rationale: Compressed low-agency play advances at most ten in-fiction minutes by default.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with ten and thirty minute caps; compare in-fiction clock drift over a low-agency stretch.

nodes.name: compression-min-beats-default
nodes.rationale: A scene without an authored budget spends at least two beats before compression can complete.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with min_beats one and two; compare the shortest compressed stretch.

nodes.name: cut-stalled-transition-turns
nodes.rationale: Stalled transition pressure on CUT starts at two stalled turns.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at one, two and three stalled turns; compare when transition pressure appears.

nodes.name: default-clock-segments
nodes.rationale: A threat clock that omits its segment count is treated as a six-segment clock, which sets both its near-full point and when it is considered complete.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint carrying a clock with no authored segments; vary the default and compare escalation timing.

nodes.name: fair-warning-lethal-chances
nodes.rationale: Lethal outcomes are downgraded until three warnings have been used, realising the rulebook's Fair Warning requirement as a deterministic ladder.
nodes.origin: Keeper Rulebook 40th Anniversary p.209, cited in coc_story_director._apply_fair_warning_ladder

nodes.name: fumble-tick-bound
nodes.rationale: A typed fumble effect may advance a clock by at most four ticks; anything larger is rejected as malformed rather than applied.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Not a pacing choice so much as an accepted bound; vary it and confirm whether any authored effect legitimately exceeds it.

nodes.name: live-affordance-merge-cap
nodes.rationale: At most six affordances survive the merge of authored and live scene state, twice the projection cap so de-duplication has room to work.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene whose authored and live affordances overlap heavily; vary the merge cap and compare what reaches the projection.

nodes.name: live-affordance-minimum
nodes.rationale: Below two affordances the projection backfills a resume line and an investigator angle, so a live scene is never presented with a single thing to do.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene with exactly one authored route; vary the minimum and compare the presented options.

nodes.name: live-affordance-return-cap
nodes.rationale: At most three affordances survive de-duplication into the projection.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene with five distinct affordances; vary the cap and compare Keeper choice quality.

nodes.name: live-affordance-route-cap
nodes.rationale: Route scanning stops once three live affordances are collected, bounding how much of a scene's exit surface one context projection carries.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a scene with six routes; vary the cap and compare whether the Keeper still finds the route the player wanted.

nodes.name: low-agency-max-beats-fallback
nodes.rationale: When neither a compression budget nor a bridge fallback is authored, four beats is the low-agency cap.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on an unbudgeted bridge scene; vary the fallback and compare when the bridge exhausts.

nodes.name: memory-callback-candidate-floor
nodes.rationale: A memory callback query asks for at least twenty candidates regardless of how few references the turn carries.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a turn with two references; vary the floor and compare whether a relevant callback is found.

nodes.name: memory-callback-overlap-weight
nodes.rationale: Each overlapping entity is worth four points of callback score, which is what ranks candidate callbacks against each other.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes where a one-entity and a three-entity callback compete; vary the weight and compare the pick.

nodes.name: memory-callback-refs-multiplier
nodes.rationale: The callback query scales at five candidates per reference, so a reference-rich turn searches proportionally wider.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a reference-rich turn; vary the multiplier and compare callback quality.

nodes.name: memory-callback-score-digits
nodes.rationale: Callback scores are rounded to three decimals.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Not independently falsifiable in play; recorded so the value is not an untracked literal.

nodes.name: mythos-signature-sample
nodes.rationale: At most two signature elements are sampled into a mythos presentation directive, so the Keeper gets a hint rather than the creature's full description.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a mythos encounter; vary the sample size and compare how much the narration gives away.

nodes.name: override-low-agency-count
nodes.rationale: Two low-agency continues with pressure available trigger the Layer-3 override that bypasses scoring entirely.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at one and two continues; compare whether the override fires and scoring is bypassed.

nodes.name: override-stalled-turns
nodes.rationale: Three stalled turns trigger the Layer-3 override, one turn later than the scoring-level stall thresholds.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at two, three and four stalled turns; compare override timing against scoring-level escalation.

nodes.name: pressure-clock-near-full-fraction
nodes.rationale: A threat clock counts as near full at two thirds of its segments, which is when PRESSURE leaves its baseline. Stored as a numerator/denominator pair because the source computes segments * 2 / 3; the quotient 0.6666666666666666 is not float-equivalent for 65 of the first 199 segment counts, including a 5-segment clock.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint with a clock at one half, two thirds and three quarters; compare when the Director escalates.

nodes.name: pressure-move-low-agency-count
nodes.rationale: Two low-agency continues also admit pressure moves regardless of the stall gate.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at one and two continues with zero stalled turns; compare pressure-move presence.

nodes.name: pressure-move-stalled-gate
nodes.rationale: Pressure moves are only built for non-PRESSURE, non-RECOVER actions once at least one turn has stalled.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at zero and one stalled turn under a REVEAL action; compare whether a pressure move accompanies the reveal.

nodes.name: pressure-posture-ceiling
nodes.rationale: Risk-posture and pushed-failure adjustments cannot lift PRESSURE past 0.95, so it stays below an explicit move intent's CUT score of 1.0.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a reckless-posture checkpoint that also has explicit move intent; raise the ceiling to 1.0 and compare PRESSURE-vs-CUT.

nodes.name: pressure-posture-floor
nodes.rationale: A cautious posture cannot drive PRESSURE below 0.05, so pressure is tempered but never removed from scoring entirely.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a cautious-posture calm checkpoint under the multi_faction weight; drop the floor to 0.0 and compare whether PRESSURE leaves scoring.

nodes.name: pressure-stalled-turns
nodes.rationale: A single stalled turn is enough to lift PRESSURE out of its baseline.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at zero and one stalled turn; compare whether the Director escalates after one quiet turn.

nodes.name: pressure-yielded-low-agency-count
nodes.rationale: Two consecutive low-agency continues with pressure available count as a yielded scene.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes replaying at one and two low-agency continues; compare escalation timing.

nodes.name: recent-intent-window
nodes.rationale: Only the last five turns of intent are kept, which bounds how far back the low-agency continue count can look and therefore how long a yielded scene stays yielded.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with a three and a ten turn window over a low-agency stretch; compare when PRESSURE and the Layer-3 override fire.

nodes.name: recover-stalled-turns
nodes.rationale: RECOVER becomes available at two stalled turns.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at one and two stalled turns; compare RECOVER availability.

nodes.name: scene-exit-pressure-continue-count
nodes.rationale: The scene-exit pressure directive is emitted from the second low-agency continue.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at one and two continues; compare whether the exit directive reaches the Keeper.

nodes.name: score-precision-digits
nodes.rationale: Weighted scores are rounded to four decimals before comparison, which decides how often two actions tie and fall through to the tiebreak order.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with two and six digits of precision on a checkpoint where two actions score within 1e-5; compare tiebreak frequency.

nodes.name: storylet-need-stalled-turns
nodes.rationale: Three stalled turns make the storylet scheduler infer a recovery-shaped story need. NOTE: this is a second copy of the same number as override-stalled-turns, maintained independently in coc_storylets.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at two, three and four stalled turns; compare when the inferred story need changes and whether it should move with the Layer-3 override.

nodes.name: storylet-recent-window
nodes.rationale: The anti-repeat 'recent' window holds eight entries, which is what makes a family or trope count as recently used and therefore excluded.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes over a long session with a four and a sixteen entry window; compare how quickly families become reusable.

nodes.name: storylet-used-targets-window
nodes.rationale: Used targets are remembered for sixteen entries, twice the recent window.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes over a session revisiting one target; vary the window and compare repetition.

nodes.name: storylet-used-window
nodes.rationale: The 'used' window is effectively unbounded at 999 entries, so the softer family and trope repeat penalties apply for the whole campaign rather than expiring.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes over a long session with a bounded used window; compare whether early families ever return to full weight.

nodes.name: time-advance-confidence-digits
nodes.rationale: Reported confidence is rounded to two decimals.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Not independently falsifiable in play; recorded so the value is not an untracked literal.

nodes.name: time-advance-deadline-confidence
nodes.rationale: Under high time pressure the proposal is reported at the lowest confidence of the three, because it is a suppression rather than a positive estimate.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with an imminent deadline; vary the confidence and compare downstream handling.

nodes.name: time-advance-deadline-delta-minutes
nodes.rationale: With a deadline imminent the proposal collapses to five minutes, the smallest advance that still moves the clock.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with an imminent deadline; vary the minimal advance and compare deadline pressure across a scene.

nodes.name: time-advance-default-confidence
nodes.rationale: A time proposal derived from the action's own profile is reported at moderate confidence, so the apply layer treats it as a proposal rather than a settled advance.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes comparing a low and a high default confidence on an ordinary turn; compare whether the apply layer's handling of the proposal changes.

nodes.name: time-advance-exhaustion-confidence
nodes.rationale: An exhaustion-driven sleep proposal is reported at higher confidence than an ordinary one, because the trigger is a measured elapsed-time signal rather than an action default.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on an exhausted investigator; vary the confidence and compare downstream handling.

nodes.name: time-advance-exhaustion-delta-minutes
nodes.rationale: The exhaustion proposal advances eight hours, one night's sleep.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes with a six-hour and an eight-hour sleep; compare which day-reset triggers fire.

nodes.name: time-advance-exhaustion-hours
nodes.rationale: Beyond eighteen hours without rest the Director proposes a sleep downtime instead of the action's own profile, so healing and sanity day-reset triggers can fire.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes at sixteen, eighteen and twenty hours since rest; compare when the sleep proposal appears.

nodes.name: director action tiebreak order
nodes.rationale: When several actions share the maximum weighted score, the first entry of this order wins. SUBSYSTEM and RECOVER lead it, so a triggered subsystem or recovery beats an equally scored reveal.
nodes.falsifiable_by: Lanes on a checkpoint that ties SUBSYSTEM with REVEAL; swap the two leading entries and compare the selected action.
